subject: Citywide Pay-to-Park Contract Agreement
overview: The Council debated the Mayor's recent signing of a ten-year citywide pay-to-park contract and discussed proposed state legislation for bicycle safety gear. The body also approved an easement for the new DPW facility and processed several congratulatory resolutions and local licenses.

items.title: Commendation for Anthony Petrellis
items.summary: The Council congratulated Anthony Petrellis on receiving the national Milken Educator Award as the sole recipient from Massachusetts.

items.title: Commendation for Bruno Bonacorsi
items.summary: The Council presented a citation to Bruno Bonacorsi in recognition of 32 years of employment with Project Triangle and his contributions to the community.

items.title: Commendation for Frederick Lasky
items.summary: The Council commended MWRA Executive Director Frederick Lasky for receiving the Norman B. Leventhal Excellence in City Building Award.

items.title: Harvester Energy Festival Announcement
items.summary: Volunteers and members of the Office of the Environment and Energy announced the fifth annual Harvester Energy Festival and its related public safety programs.

items.title: Waste Management Vehicle Inspections
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting Waste Management inspect its fleet for fluid leaks and provide a comprehensive financial report on the city's recycling contract.

items.title: Massachusetts Electric Company Easement
items.summary: Approved an easement for the Massachusetts Electric Company to provide service to the new Department of Public Works facility on James Street.

items.title: Mailing Procedures for Special Permits
items.summary: Approved the use of regular first-class mail for abutter notifications regarding a Coles extended hours hearing and referred the broader mailing procedure to the Rules Committee.

items.title: Bicycle Safety State Law Proposal
items.summary: Referred a proposal to seek state legislation requiring reflective vests for night cyclists to the Bicycle Advisory Commission for further review.

items.title: Citywide Pay-to-Park Contract Position
items.summary: Tabled a resolution regarding the Mayor’s signing of a ten-year parking enforcement contract to allow members time to review the final document.

items.title: Tufts University Sexual Assault Policy
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting Tufts University provide its campus sexual assault handling policy for review by local law enforcement and the District Attorney.

items.title: License Approvals
items.summary: Approved a taxi cab upgrade for Citywide Tax, Inc. and a common victualler license for DE's Convenience at 308 Main Street.

items.title: Electronic Cigarette Regulation
items.summary: Referred a request to examine banning electronic cigarettes in smoke-free establishments to the Board of Health and the State Department of Public Health.

items.title: Infrastructure and Signage Requests
items.summary: Approved requests to reinstall a missing parking permit sign on Capen Street and repair a sinking section of the roadway on Stearns Avenue.
